title: Figure Retired Its Old Robots… in Molten Steel
description:
Figure retired its F.02 humanoid robots by training them to leap, on their own, into a 75-ton furnace of molten steel at a foundry in Imatra, Finland.
The team had 24 hours and six melts, about 20 minutes each, and the idea to melt them came from Arnold Schwarzenegger.
